hook2.text: That is how many premature deaths a year in Kazakhstan are linked to air pollution.

hook3.text: [quietly] Up to two thousand one hundred of them... in Almaty.

problem.text: The research to protect people already exists: a hundred and fifty reports by Almaty Air Initiative. [pause] But nobody reads a hundred and fifty reports... for one answer.

meet.text: So we built Taza Copilot. Meet three people. Three questions. One day in Almaty.

arman1.text: Seven a.m. Arman starts his first shift with inDrive. His question: windows open, or shut?

arman2.text: Before the first ride, Taza tells him the cleanest hours, and the worst. And why to keep the windows shut: in a jam with open windows, drivers breathe air seven times dirtier than pedestrians. [pause] AAI's research, page five.

arman3.text: One call to Taza's partner API. For drivers and for riders. In three languages.

aliya1.text: Eight fifteen. Aliya has two kids, and one question: can they walk to school today? [pause] She doesn't open websites. She opens WhatsApp.

aliya2.text: And when her hands are full... she just calls.

tg.text: On Telegram, Taza lives where parents already talk: a daily air card for the school, questions by voice, rumours checked, saved places and alerts.

dana1.text: Six thirty a.m. Dana is a journalist, on deadline. Her question: did the air really get cleaner? [pause] A media request like hers used to take AAI's team about five hours of work.

dana2.text: Taza answers in seconds. With the exact quote, the page, and the link. And when the research doesn't cover something, it says so.

dana3.text: She compares districts, years, even other cities. Checks a claim. And turns the answer into a policy brief.

voice.text: Or she just talks to it. The voice agent answers out loud, and shows her the map.

admin.text: Behind it all: the AAI team. One person, no code. Upload a report, and Taza quotes it seconds later. Subscribers get a five-point summary. And an outdated source is hidden in one click.

dash.text: Every answer is measured. Forty-four out of forty-four on the accuracy test. Ninety-nine percent of answers with a source.

cost.text: Any AI provider works: Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepInfra. [pause] Or a local model with Ollama, where the AI cost is zero. Hosting: about seven dollars a month.

metric.text: [serious] From hours of reading reports... to a sourced answer in seconds.

close.text: Taza won't clean the air. [pause] But no one in Almaty should have to guess about it anymore.

thanks.text: Thank you. Try it, right now. [pause] And now... over to Aimira.

c_en_q.text: Hi Taza! Can my kids walk to school this morning?

c_en_a.text: Yes, the morning is one of the cleanest times today, around thirty-four micrograms. Avoid eight to ten in the evening: it gets close to eighty.

c_ru_q.text: А какая школа в Алматы с самым грязным воздухом?

c_ru_a.text: По исследованию AAI — школа номер сто пятьдесят шесть в Алатауском районе: семьдесят один и три десятых микрограмма за отопительный сезон.

c_kk_q.text: Ал қазір қай ауданда ауа ең лас?

c_kk_a.text: Қазір ең лас аудан — Түрксіб: PM2.5 жүз сексен сегіз микрограмм.
